name: Google Cast
description: Android TV and Google TV, Chromecasts, Nest speakers and displays on your network: what plays, volume and playback.
author: LocalAssistant

connection.description: LocalAssistant looks for Cast devices on your network over mDNS and keeps up with what they play. Nothing to sign in to: turn it on and it searches.
connection.connected: Cast devices on your network show up when you look for them. Their volume and what they play follow live.

device.title: Add a Cast device by its address
device.description: When looking for them finds nothing: mDNS doesn't cross a Docker bridge network, so a container needs host networking to find them. Give the device a fixed IP in your router and type it here.

fields.name: host
fields.label: IP address
fields.message: Type the device's IP address on your network.
